title: Reverse Swing — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Reverse swing is for later in the day
When the ball is old and the pitch is tired
And the batsman thinks the hard part is over
That's when reverse swing says — actually

[Verse 2 — Español]
El swing inverso es para más tarde en el día [Reverse swing is for later in the day]
Cuando la pelota es vieja y el campo está cansado [When the ball is old and the pitch is tired]
Y el bateador cree que la parte difícil ha terminado [And the batsman thinks the hard part is over]
Eso es cuando el swing inverso dice — en realidad [That's when reverse swing says — actually]

[Chorus — English]
Reverse swing says — you've been here before
Reverse swing says — except you haven't
Reverse swing says — you know what an old ball does
Reverse swing says — not this old ball

[Bridge — Français]
Le swing inversé dit — tu as déjà été ici [Reverse swing says — you've been here before]
Le swing inversé dit — sauf que non [Reverse swing says — except you haven't]
Le swing inversé dit — tu sais ce que fait une vieille balle [Reverse swing says — you know what an old ball does]
Le swing inversé dit — pas cette vieille balle [Reverse swing says — not this old ball]

[Verse 3 — English]
The late movement, the disbelief on the batsman's face
That's reverse swing saying hello

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
Reverse swing
Swing inverso [Reverse swing]
Le swing inversé [Reverse swing]
That's my boy
